name: Research Peptide Certificate of Analysis (CoA) Field Taxonomy
purpose: A machine-readable coding scheme for the fields that appear on a research-grade peptide Certificate of Analysis (CoA). Used to normalise CoA documents for procurement review, to score documentation completeness, and to feed automated extraction.

conventions.required: field must be present on a buyer-grade CoA
conventions.recommended: field materially affects the buyer's ability to verify identity/purity
conventions.optional: field is informative but not decision-critical
conventions.units: SI where applicable; ppm for elemental/water content; % as area-% for chromatographic purity and mass-% for assay

fields.label: Product name
fields.notes: Trivial name plus systematic/INN where one exists.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.notes: One-letter code; note D-amino acids, N-terminal acetylation and C-terminal amidation explicitly.

fields.label: Molecular formula
fields.notes: Must include counter-ion and hydration state where known.

fields.label: Salt / counter-ion form
fields.notes: e.g. acetate, TFA, hydrochloride. TFA content changes both mass and biological comparability.

fields.label: Batch / lot number
fields.notes: Must be traceable to the testing report.

fields.label: Chromatographic purity
fields.notes: State the detection wavelength and method; area-% is not the same as content.

fields.label: Assay / content
fields.notes: Mass balance basis for the declared quantity.

fields.label: Impurity profile
fields.notes: Individual named impurities above the reporting threshold.

fields.label: Mass spectrometry result
fields.notes: Observed vs theoretical; include the ion mode.

fields.label: Residual solvents
fields.notes: Where applicable to the synthesis route.

fields.label: Trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) content
fields.notes: Relevant when the salt form matters for downstream assay.

fields.label: Storage conditions
fields.notes: Temperature and light protection; state whether lyophilised or in solution.

fields.label: Testing laboratory
fields.notes: Name and, where available, accreditation or registration identifier.

scoring.method: Count required fields present / total required fields, then subtract penalties for internal inconsistency.

penalties.condition: Declared molecular weight differs from sequence-derived value by more than 1.0 Da
Chromatographic purity reported without method or wavelength
Batch number on the CoA cannot be matched to the shipped label
Mass spectrum shown without observed/theoretical comparison

bands.interpretation: Auditable documentation; suitable for institutional procurement files.
Usable, with named gaps to request before release.
Incomplete; request a re-issued CoA for the specific batch.
Not verifiable from documentation alone; treat as unconfirmed.

common_omissions: Method parameters for the purity determination (column, gradient, wavelength)
Observed vs theoretical mass in the MS section
Salt / counter-ion form, which changes both mass and assay interpretation
Named testing laboratory and report identifier
Batch-level traceability between the CoA, the label and the shipment
Karl Fischer water content, which affects net peptide content in lyophilised powder
